text:
Elena (CEO): Morning team — quick exec update for the week. Highlights:
• Dedicated beta: internal canary is green. Plan: invite-only beta next Tue.
• Cost: Optimize rollout reduced per-token cost ~12%. Target another 5% via batching and cache tweaks.
• Reliability: last week's failover exposed a routing race; Sam's team has a patch. We have a 72-hr rollback window.
• GTM: three late-stage deals >$250k; growth momentum steady.
Asks: product + eng prioritize Dedicated canary stability; ops — hold infra changes until after Tue; finance — finalize Q2 forecast.

Elena (CEO): Canary rollout schedule:
```
Tue 09:00 - invite batch 1
Tue 13:00 - invite batch 2
Wed 09:00 - open beta
```

Priya (VP Product): Thanks — shifting two E2E tests to high priority, adding the customer prompt sets we discussed. Will share by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Jon (VP Eng): Noted. Infra freeze acknowledged. Routing patch is in PR #789; canary shows p95 and error-rate back to baseline. @Marco please confirm monitoring.

Marco (Head SRE): Patch deployed to canary at 08:30; dashboards updated. Running a limited chaos test Wed 10:00. Will post results in #incidents. :mag:

Sam (Director SRE): Root cause: race in model-router when fallback triggered under simultaneous KV cache evictions. Hotfix adds a lightweight lock around KV writes; full postmortem tomorrow.

Liam (Finance): I'll update the Q2 forecast with the new per-token assumptions and circulate before COB Friday.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-20_08:30 completed on canary (hash abc123). :white_check_mark:

Elena (CEO): Two final asks — (1) product to list top-3 customer prompts we expect in beta; (2) eng to validate quantization profiles for the models we'll serve. Thanks everyone, great cross-functional push this week. :rocket:

Priya (VP Product): Will send prompts by 17:00. :thumbsup:

Jon (VP Eng): We'll validate quant profiles and report infra cost impacts by Monday.

Marco (Head SRE): Will hold infra changes until after the beta window. Monitoring playbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/canary

Elena (CEO): Appreciated. Quick pulse — anyone blocking on resources? If so, DM me.

Priya (VP Product): No blockers. Thanks!
